params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { items: [{ id, title, summary }], id: currentId|null, anchor: headingId|null, search?, home?: { title, summary }, level?: 1/2/3 (the title heading level; default 1) }.

params.name: LoadItem
params.doc: Loads the page for an item id (config.items[].id): an object with title, summary and html (the body, trusted markup). Null or nothing shows the 'not found' state; throwing shows the error state with Retry.

notes: The nav, bar and aside slots are deliberately not mapped (#1409): the element builds and owns them itself (the contents side-nav, the menu toggle and the on-this-page toc), so a host fragment there would be clobbered or would fight it. New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353), the doc slice only (workspace, master-detail, record, wizard are separate future steps). LoadItem(id) is a callback property, set from script: the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the LoadItem parameter (issue #366). Href is synchronous in the element and cannot cross interop, and the pk-navigate event is still unmapped; both wait for a design decision.
